Visit note | 2025-10-09 04:30 PM | Dr. Sharmin Akter, Obstetrics and Gynecology | Patient: Dalia Kabir, 24, female. Ms. Kabir returns for review regarding her irregular periods, acne, and weight gain. She mentioned she noticed weight gain after starting a desk job in Faridpur. She has a history of Bronchial asthma, which remains stable without recent attacks. She reports using her inhalers as needed and denies excessive hair growth or severe pelvic pain. On examination: BMI 31.1, BP 130/81 mmHg, pulse 70 bpm, weight 89 kg. Abdominal examination is unremarkable. Assessment: Polycystic ovary syndrome. Plan: a prescription was issued to help regulate her cycle and skin symptoms. She was advised to aim for 5% weight loss, exercise 150 minutes a week, and reduce sugary drinks. Follow-up in 3 months.

Visit note | 2025-10-11 09:00 AM | Dr. Rumana Haque, Endocrinology | Patient: Yusuf Pramanik, 74, male. Mr. Pramanik attends for a follow-up consultation, reporting persistent dry skin, gradual weight gain, and feeling slow and tired. He is a shopkeeper who first noted these symptoms when he was found during tests for tiredness after moving to Banani. He has no known comorbidities and takes his prescribed hormone replacement regularly. He denies chest pain, shortness of breath, or memory issues. On examination: TSH 11.9 mIU/L, BP 124/81 mmHg, pulse 84 bpm, weight 92 kg. Heart sounds are normal and peripheral pulses are intact. Assessment: Hypothyroidism. Plan: a prescription was issued to adjust his treatment dosage. He was advised to keep a regular sleep routine and eat a balanced diet. Follow-up in 6 weeks with a repeat TSH.

Visit note | 2025-10-11 09:00 AM | Dr. Selina Parvin, Neurology | Patient: Shafiq Bepari, 71, male. Mr. Bepari presents for his first visit complaining of a brief spinning sensation when turning in bed and dizziness when looking up. He is a homemaker whose symptoms began after bumping his head on a rickshaw hood in Shyamoli. He has no significant past medical history and denies headaches, weakness, or hearing loss. On examination: Dix-Hallpike test positive on the right side, BP 128/70 mmHg, pulse 89 bpm, weight 49 kg. Cranial nerves are intact and coordination is normal. Assessment: Benign paroxysmal positional vertigo. Plan: a prescription was issued for symptom relief. He was advised to get up slowly from bed, avoid sudden head movements, and repeat the Epley manoeuvre at home as shown. Follow-up in 2 weeks.

Visit note | 2025-10-11 09:30 AM | Dr. Tahmina Begum, Dermatology | Patient: Lipi Munshi, 23, female. Ms. Munshi attends a review visit for her skin concerns, describing spots on her back, pimples and blackheads on the face, and marks left after pimples. She works as a graphic designer and states her skin has been worse since working in a hot kitchen in Badda. She has a history of Essential hypertension, which is well controlled on medication. She denies fever or systemic symptoms. On examination: about 33 inflamed spots on the face, BP 149/87 mmHg, pulse 74 bpm, weight 73 kg. Skin inspection shows papules and comedones across the T-zone and back. Assessment: Acne vulgaris. Plan: a prescription was issued for topical and oral therapy. She was advised to wash the face twice daily with a gentle cleanser and not to squeeze spots. Follow-up in 2 months.

Visit note | 2025-10-11 10:00 AM | Dr. Mostafizur Rahman, Orthopedics | Patient: Tamanna Mondal, 80, female.
